Tally Pro includes custom domains for forms.

strategy:
6 competitor(s) read - potential open ground on speed, price, breadth, quality, effort, security, proof, support, other.
This map compares captured claims from the pages read, not complete product capabilities. Unread pages and extraction omissions remain unknown. Open ground is a hypothesis to verify, never proof of exclusivity or of a rival's inability.

**Shared category vocabulary.** Two or more competitors use these. Keep the words needed to explain the product; common vocabulary alone does not make a proposition generic. Avoid unsupported superlatives:
- data, custom, form, forms, responses, email, enterprise, logic, offers, organizations, plan, plans, security, sso, unlimited, workflows

Current product knowledge is compared with saved competitor pages; check their capture dates before making time-sensitive comparisons.

**Supported product propositions.** Use their stated conditions. An unmatched capture is a question to verify, not exclusivity.
- **Tally Pro lets users remove Tally branding from forms.** [control; potential_difference] Related captures: SurveyMonkey, Jotform, Fillout. Related propositions differ in the task, object, format or captured scope.
- **Entrepreneur and creator Thomas Frank uses Tally forms to guide development of his web clipper tool, Flylighter** [proof; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Thomas Frank used Tally forms to achieve 30%+ response rates collecting product feedback for his web clipper tool, Flylighter** [other; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally lets you add a file upload field to any form and start collecting images, PDFs, videos, audio files, and documents in minutes.** [speed; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally translates default form messages into 40+ languages.** [breadth; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally Business can verify email addresses from form respondents, improving data reliability** [quality; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally lets users create checkout forms to accept payments without code.** [effort; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally Business can automatically delete form submissions after a set period to comply with privacy frameworks** [security; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **All form data is securely stored and encrypted both in transit and at rest.** [support; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally Business costs $89/month or $890/year (2 months off)** [price; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally Pro includes custom domains for forms.** [control; potential_difference] Related captures: Jotform, Fillout. Related propositions differ in the task, object, format or captured scope.
- **Jac, scaling global teams in Web3, said: "Non stop new features and amazing UX makes Tally my go-to form builder. I love using it!"** [proof; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **99% of Tally's features are available to all users without limits on the number of forms, submissions, or questions.** [other; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **If a webhook delivery fails, Tally retries after 5 minutes, then 30 minutes, then 1 hour, then 6 hours, then 1 day.** [speed; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally's Form Visit Analytics tracks key metrics such as visits, visit duration, and traffic sources** [breadth; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Business plan can verify respondents' email addresses to capture high-quality leads and increase conversions** [quality; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally is a Belgium-based (EU) company that fully complies with GDPR requirements and stores all form data in Europe** [security; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.
- **Tally paid plans can be cancelled anytime** [support; unknown] no competing claim captured; rival capability remains unknown.

**Information missing from our captured material.** Research before comparing. Do not infer a missing capability or competitor superiority.
- **Forms can be shared via own custom domain, QR code, or email** [breadth; unknown] Our captured material does not support a matching promise. Do not infer a missing capability or competitor superiority; verify it before making a comparison.
- **Follows up instantly across email, SMS, and other tools, triggered from any form submission or contact update** [speed; unknown] Our captured material does not support a matching promise. Do not infer a missing capability or competitor superiority; verify it before making a comparison.
- **Build the form you need in minutes** [speed; unknown] Our captured material does not support a matching promise. Do not infer a missing capability or competitor superiority; verify it before making a comparison.
